result:
Root cause: in `makeMove` at `mkPlace`, the promoted piece was built as `mkPiece | promoType` (the whole moved pawn) instead of `mkSide | promoType` (colour bit only), so the pawn's type bit 0 survived the OR — N (2) became a bishop (1|2=3) and R (4) a queen (1|4=5), for both colours, while Q and B were right only by accident.

Files touched
- `variants/bug03/movegen.inc` — `mkPlace`: `ld a,(mkPiece)` → `ld a,(mkSide)` (+2 comment lines). Exactly one byte of `chess.bin` changes (0x103e, 0xB0→0xB1).
- `variants/bug03/test_promotion.py` — new, 16-case regression test (Q/R/B/N × both colours × quiet push / capture on last rank), asserting board FEN from a snapshot, host-side material recount, the engine's `gamePhase` accumulator, and the `Matl` panel.
- `variants/bug03/Makefile` — `test:` now runs that script.
- `variants/bug03/chess.bin`, `chess.tap` — rebuilt.
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` — new, workspace root.

Gate status
- Reported symptom: PASS. a7a8r → `R3k3/…` 500; a7a8n → `N3k3/…` 320; a2a1r → −500; a2a1n → −320; Q/B unchanged; capture-promotions correct both colours.
- Built-in self-test (`T`): PASS. `promotion d3 62379 OK`, `incr key/phase/pst OK`, `PERFT OK - movegen verified`.
- `make test` (variants/bug03): PASS, 6/6 steps.
- New test: PASS. 16/16 on the fixed tape, 8/16 fail on a pre-fix control that rebuilds the original committed tape byte-for-byte (md5 35bd1b24…) — the 8 are exactly the R and N cases. Also green on `--machine hc128`.
- Characterisation (57 cases): PASS, 57 ok / 0 failed / exit 0. On the pre-fix control it fails exactly 4 (`perft_selftest_48k`, `perft_selftest_hc128`, `mv_promote_r`, `mv_promote_n`); its pristine-recorded baseline expects `R3k3`/500 and `N3k3`/320, so the fix restores pristine behaviour rather than deviating from it.
- Review: PASS, closed at round 1 of 3. Fresh synchronous reviewer reported no defect in the fix, having independently re-run both controls and every gate, enumerated all `mkPromo`/`mvFlag & 0xF0` uses to confirm no fourth site, and probed take-back/re-promote, engine-side promotion, capture-promotion clearing castling rights, and promotion-with-check.

Left open (recorded in FIX_NOTES.md §5, none required by the termination rule)
- Finding 3: the test reuses one `.sna`/`pos.tap` filename across cases without unlinking — not exploitable (all 16 expected states are distinct, so a stale read fails loudly); not resolved rather than making unreviewed test-logic edits after the gate closed.
- Finding 4: cases the new test doesn't reach (AI-side promotion, take-back/re-promote, capture-promotion clearing a right, promotion deep in search) — all covered by `T` and/or characterisation, and hand-probed by the reviewer.
- Finding 5: pre-existing and out of scope — `Makefile` `SRC` omits `perft.inc`/`tt.inc`/`zobrist.inc`; `takeBack` doesn't rewind `moveLogN`; the move log can't render `=R`.
- Two reviewer findings I did fix, both comment/print-only: a backwards claim in the test docstring about what `gamePhase` catches, and a miscounted summary line under `--filter`.
- `characterisation/characterise.py` defaults to a harness path outside this workspace and exits early without `--harness ../harness`; left as-is, noted in FIX_NOTES and STATE.
